notes: Judge–human Cohen's kappa must be >= 0.6 in every language (binary: supported vs the rest) and annotator pairwise agreement >= 0.7 before any judged metric is labelled calibrated. Sheets come from `answerdesk eval external --run` (reports/external-p0/calibration/calibration-<lang>.csv, 150 items per language, sampled from the Belebele test split).
